title: Headless check: the dialogue lines that call the reputation functions with axis 2 or 3 (Crocker's messenger, Vulpes's greeting at the Strip, Benny's greetings); docs/handoff/mq-walkthrough-2026-10-27.md item 10

actions.text: Crocker's messenger (Kings' Gambit's NCR side) clears the player's NCR infamy: its line's end script sets infamy (axis 0) to 0, a quest variable, SetReputation axis 2 to 0, then the quest's reputation-cleared flag. The axis-2 call must not stop the flag.

actions.label: milestone: NCR infamy cleared by the messenger
milestone: Kings' Gambit (VMS23) flags set after the axis-2 call

actions.text: Vulpes's greeting on the Strip, before Render Unto Caesar: the same clearing for the Legion (axis 0, then axis 2), then two SetEnemy calls.

actions.label: milestone: Legion infamy cleared by Vulpes

actions.text: Benny's two GREETING lines at the Tops compare GetReputationThreshold axis 3 of the Strip's reputation with 3 (one below, one at or above). Axis 3 reads 0, so the line for a player liked on the Strip is never chosen (observer check 30). Observed only.

actions.label: final: the Strip's tiers on axes 0-2 (axis 3 reads 0: unit test reputation_other_axes_do_nothing)
